_comment: EdgeLogBridge rails. L1 (live account 1810769) is refused in COMPILED CODE regardless of this file. L2 = accounts below. L3 = orders_enabled. L5 = the risk block.
_risk_comment: L5 circuit breaker + position-size gate. risk_enabled turns BOTH on. The monitor re-reads this file every 10s, so changes take effect without restarting NinjaTrader. Code defaults are conservative, so a typo here falls back to a limit rather than to no limit.
_margin_comment: margin_per_contract_usd 0 = UNKNOWN, so the margin leg is SKIPPED rather than guessed. Set it to the broker's intraday initial margin for the contract you trade to switch that leg on; the size and rate legs work regardless.
